title: Number Patterns and Ordered Pairs
intro: Teach paired number patterns with a two-column table.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Apply each rule in its own column and pair values from the same row. Connect each pair to a point on the coordinate grid.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Starting at 0, add 2 for x and add 3 for y. The pairs are (0, 0), (2, 3), (4, 6), and (6, 9).

Ask your student

Which two values belong to the same step in the patterns?

If your student needs help

If the student reverses coordinates, label the columns x and y and trace a point from the origin.
